title: Named-service admission, multicast and durable receipts
summary: Service registration and FIRST admission are transport filters. Queue Fabric must still authenticate channel/manager/ACL; XTP reliable multicast ACK is not a committed Queue Fabric receiver UOW.
invariants: Queue Fabric transferId remains stable on retries, even when XTP context KEY changes.
Sender retries use RELEASE rather than application NACK/backoutCount.
Distributed topic subscriptions aggregate per interested manager; multicast groups are an explicit independent mapping.
Retirement of a durable distributed publication requires each interested manager's durable receiver receipt, not XTP quorum.
Unknown membership epoch, partial quorum, crash or expiry must retain intents and use idempotent per-manager repair.
Local subscriber fan-out, retained state and distribution receipt share a local UOW; there is no distributed XA.
